title: An off-by-one error in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby user to send a packet with a…
description: An off-by-one error in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby attacker to send a specially crafted packet with a specific header length. This can potentially overwrite memory and cause the affected service to crash. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-88708 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
